summary: HeartSciences filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing voluntary supplemental proxy disclosures tied to its pending acquisition of Fortitude HoldCo from Fortitude Seller (a Digital Currency Group subsidiary) under a June 23, 2026 merger agreement, amended July 27, 2026. Merger Sub, a HeartSciences subsidiary, merges into Fortitude HoldCo, which survives. After the preliminary and definitive proxies, seven shareholder demand letters alleged disclosure omissions; the company denies merit but adds disclosures to avoid delay and litigation expense. Terms, price, premium and closing date were not stated in the excerpt. Watch the shareholder vote and any further litigation or demands.
